landing_meta_description: Every media you love, translated into your language, synced across every device.
landing_hero_subtitle: Every media you love, translated into your language and synced across every device. A sunrise waits each time you open it.
landing_flaws_title: Reasons to use literally anything else.
landing_flaw_broken_body: Vibe-coded to hell and back. Every deploy breaks something… Nobody tests shit around here, the users are the test.
landing_flaw_catalog_body: We're easily 10k manga short of other sites. Don't get your hopes up.

landing_flaw_team_body: It's two of us, tops. Not great.
landing_flaw_app_body: Some sites have a nice mobile app and all that. Not here. There's the website, figure it out yourselves.
